notes: The live BISD test SIS references REG-style eSchoolPlus tables rather than classic PowerSchool student tables.
PowerSchool mappings are kept only as comparison aliases where that helps translation.

table_families.meaning: Latest captured student registration snapshot and campus assignment record.
Program participation and value assignments for students.
District enrollment history timeline tracking student enrollment within the school district, including campus/date history and in-year grade movement.

usage_patterns.why: REG reflects the latest captured student record.
REG_ENTRY_WITH preserves when and where the grade change happened during the year.
REG_ENTRY_WITH is the stronger source for enrollment movement across time and campuses.

fields.label: Student ID
fields.definition: Student number known to students and staff, not an internally generated identifier.

fields.label: Last Name
fields.definition: Legal last name of the student.

fields.label: First Name
fields.definition: First name of the student.

fields.label: School ID / Building
fields.definition: ID of the school the student attends within the district.

fields.label: Enrollment Status
fields.definition: Tracks whether the student is preregistered, active, graduated, or inactive.

fields.label: Birthdate
fields.definition: Student date of birth.

fields.label: Counselor
fields.definition: Assigned counselor name or employee identifier.

fields.label: Mailing Address (City)
fields.definition: Student physical or mailing city.

fields.label: Mailing Address (State)
fields.definition: Student physical or mailing state.

fields.label: Mailing Address (Zip)
fields.definition: Student physical or mailing ZIP code.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.definition: Preferred student email for school communication.

fields.label: Naviance Student Username
fields.definition: Student login identifier used when federated IDs are required.

fields.label: Ethnicity
fields.definition: Ethnicity marker used in standard reporting categories.

fields.label: State Reporting ID
fields.definition: State-issued student identifier used for reporting.

fields.label: Global ID
fields.definition: Global identity value tied to secure SIS identity layers.

fields.label: Cumulative GPA
fields.definition: Student GPA value used for weighted or unweighted GPA depending on GPA type code.

fields.label: Cumulative Rank
fields.definition: Student class rank value.

fields.label: Cumulative Decile
fields.definition: Student rank position by decile.

fields.label: Graduation Year
fields.definition: Graduation year or class-year style academic summary field.

fields.label: District Enrollment History
fields.definition: District enrollment timeline records for students within the school district. Use this table for enrollment-history and current-year grade-change questions, while REG remains the latest captured student record.

fields.label: Historical Grade Level
fields.definition: Grade value as recorded at that point in the student enrollment timeline. This is the better source for identifying when a grade change happened during the year.

fields.label: Historical Campus / Building
fields.definition: Campus or building recorded for that timeline event, useful for where a grade or enrollment change happened.

fields.label: Entry Date
fields.definition: Date associated with the start of that enrollment timeline record.

fields.label: Withdraw Date
fields.definition: Date associated with the end of that enrollment timeline record when applicable.
